name: tempo
description: Tempo 1.14.0 isolated development chain with loopback RPC at 127.0.0.1:8645; no public network or production consensus.
prepare:
import hashlib,io,json,pathlib,platform,subprocess,tarfile,urllib.request
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace'); root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
assets={'x86_64': {'url': 'https://github.com/tempoxyz/tempo/releases/download/v1.14.0/tempo-v1.14.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz', 'sha256': '93afdfe95395893acd294f9924ae89a3b1c90f8503fefb1b5cec43a3c7d86357'}, 'aarch64': {'url': 'https://github.com/tempoxyz/tempo/releases/download/v1.14.0/tempo-v1.14.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz', 'sha256': 'd55092a9a0cf52e14df0dc00dfe09e575e71e2f0cf6e46d6107ddf1d5a8302e9'}}
asset=assets[platform.machine()]
data=urllib.request.urlopen(asset['url'],timeout=120).read()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==asset['sha256'], 'Archive digest mismatch'
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data),mode='r:gz') as archive:
    for name in ['tempo']:
        matches=[m for m in archive.getmembers() if pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name).name==asset['url'].rsplit('/',1)[1].removesuffix('.tar.gz') and m.isfile()]
        assert len(matches)==1, 'Expected one executable: '+name
        binary=root/name; binary.write_bytes(archive.extractfile(matches[0]).read()); binary.chmod(0o700)
        subprocess.run([str(binary),'--version'],check=True)
